title: Image grader and pack
acceptance: Grader S+V: structural checks first (decode, size, format, not blank, simple pixel facts), then a checklist of fixed yes/no or count questions answered as JSON at temperature 0 by a pinned local vision model; the verdict is a pure function of the image and the pinned judge
Proven by committed pass and fail fixture images (a few kilobytes each, invented), with a fixture judge standing in for the model in CI, written failing first
examples/image-generation-v1.json, area audio-video, six to eight cases split regression and holdout, with checklist questions a correct image answers unambiguously; index entry regenerated
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 in the domain-packs plan (owner request) at observed agent speed for one-PR pack steps. Not a measurement. Re-planned 2026-11-26 to the owner's decision.
